message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: test

on:
  push:
    branches:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python:
          - "3.10"
          - "3.14"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: install apt packages
        # pycurl build requirements
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get -y install \
              libcurl4-gnutls-dev \
              libgnutls28-dev \
              libmemcached-dev

      - name: install
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install -r requirements.in -r requirements-dev.txt
          python3 -m pip install -v -e .
      - name: install mypy
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install mypy types-pycurl types-requests types-Markdown pyflakes
      - name: run mypy
        run: |
          mypy nbviewer
      - name: run pyflakes
        run: |
          pyflakes nbviewer

      - name: pip freeze
        run: |
          python3 -m pip freeze

      - name: run tests
        run: |
          pytest -v nbviewer/tests -s
",
  "rationale": "The workflow reinstalls Python dependencies (requirements.in, requirements-dev.txt, and the editable package) on every matrix job with no dependency cache, so packages are re-fetched on each run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (Cache dependency downloads) and the matching measured experiment add an actions/cache step for ~/.cache/pip keyed on the dependency manifest hash, placed after setup-python and before installation. The repository has pyproject.toml, each matrix job runs a single Python version on its own runner, and all existing install/typecheck/test steps are preserved unchanged, so build/test coverage is intact. No permissions, secrets, deployment, or new network access is added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
